checks: Principal and reward credit require authenticated actual inbound DETF transfer deltas; unsolicited balances are not newly credited income.
Funded reward allocation reduces gons-per-unit before fee/creator receipt issuance; standing weights do not become redeemable liabilities.
Full-account withdrawals retire fractional gons and retain released liability as accounted staking dust.
Bond principal uses fixed linear vesting, rewards subtract remaining principal without hiding a deficit, and claims debit attributed gons before payout.
Epoch calculation uses whole fixed eight-hour intervals, actual current supply, retained per-epoch floor order and one aggregate mint; zero-eligible intervals still advance the boundary.
documentation_correction: Plan §6.1 now names the actual lastExpansionTimestamp boundary and removes its obsolete instruction to store a second write-only epochAnchor.
limitations: Source inspection complements the existing unit/proxy tests and the running complete validation; it is not a formal proof or a substitute for actual integration results.
